title: Polynomial presentation at a closed point of the special fibre
statement: Let $R\to S$ be an essentially finite type homomorphism of commutative rings, with $R$ and $S$ local rings (the map need not be local), and let $\mathfrak m_R$ be the maximal ideal of $R$. Then for some $n\ge0$ there is a maximal ideal $\mathfrak n\subset R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ lying over $\mathfrak m_R$ such that $S$ is a localization of a quotient of $R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]_{\mathfrak n}$. A localization means a ring of fractions $T^{-1}D$ for a subset $T\subset D$ containing $1$ and closed under multiplication; a local ring has exactly one maximal ideal.
